decisions.reason: This candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording separate LED and sensor power control, plus an AMBIGUOUS Event recording the unresolved level-shifter question; no additional or corrected MODIFY is required.
Separate LED and sensor power control does not change the charge-status indicator, connector, GPIO, or resistor requirements.
The battery connector, pinout, placement, and AXP2101 connection remain unaffected by separate control of LEDs and sensors.
The source decision does not alter the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology or net labeling.
Separate LED and sensor load control does not change battery overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection requirements.
The battery NTC monitoring method is independent of the LED and sensor power-control separation.
The source decision does not change the power board's eight-layer stack.
Separate electrical control of LEDs and sensors does not entail any change to board dimensions, mounting, connector placement, or enclosure fit.
The source decision does not affect the requirement for TVS-based ESD protection.
The USB-C connector functionality and sourceability requirements are unrelated to separate LED and sensor power control.
The source decision does not change the 3.3V source OR-ing method, sources, or source-selection behavior.

The candidate concerns standalone USB operation of the complete 3.3V rail, while the source concerns separate control of LED and sensor loads associated with the switched 5V supply; no change to the standalone-power state is entailed.
